description: Signing certificates of known AI generation tools. A C2PA manifest signed by one of these certificates is reported as evidence that the content is AI-generated, even though the signer is not on a C2PA trust list. Evidence that lowers the human share of a work is accepted; this list never makes a signer trusted for claims that support human authorship. Fingerprints are base64-encoded SHA-256 digests of the DER signing certificate, the format the C2PA SDK expects in an allowed list.

signers.name: BytePlus Lumina (Seed Audio)
signers.certificate_issuer: CN=GlobalSign GCC R45 SMIME CA 2025, O=GlobalSign nv-sa
